event: SSDI program created (1956); disability definition tightened (1967)

sources.description: Created the SSDI program; initial disability definition
sources.note: URL from authoritative knowledge — verify at govinfo.gov

sources.description: Added 12-month durational requirement; added 'any work in national economy' language at § 423(d)(2)(A)
sources.note: URL from authoritative knowledge — verify at govinfo.gov

significance: The 1967 amendment fixed the disability definition that still governs today. The 12-month durational requirement and the national economy scope are both 1967 additions. The core § 423(d)(1)(A) text has been unchanged for 58 years.
